hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative one, four and four, negative four. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative one, four to four, four that is labeled five. There is a vertical dotted segment from four, four to four, negative four that is labeled negative eight.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{8}{5}$.
